capabilities: Read RSS, Atom, YouTube, and podcast feeds in a built-in reader
Save articles to the vault as Markdown with templates, frontmatter variables, and tagging
Organize feeds into folders and subfolders with custom tags, filters, and sorting
Import and export subscriptions as OPML, including starred articles from Inoreader or FreshRSS
Discover new feeds via a curated Discover page and Kagi Smallweb
extras: Twitter/X feed support via the Nitter integration was removed in version 2.7.0 after Nitter shut down; detailed guides, a public roadmap, and troubleshooting live in external documentation and Discord.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to subscribe to and read RSS feeds, YouTube channels, or podcasts, so users must switch to separate reader apps to consume that content.

relations.evidence: Migrating from Inoreader or FreshRSS? Import your starred articles directly.

browse smaller independent blogs through Kagi Smallweb

summary: Feed-reader dashboard that aggregates RSS, Atom, YouTube channels, and podcasts into Obsidian, with a built-in reader and article saving as Markdown notes.
